author: @marynnalindseykerce7510
text:
0:58  The timing!  See 0:59 and 1:05.  The choreographic contrast against the coordination of the chorus, packs expressive perfection into each tiny fraction of each millisecond.  The spareness of the set, the brilliant minimalist camerawork, exposes every millisecond of movement.  The master, vulnerable, fully exposed.  

The sensei of sensei.  The matrix.  Jimin, we hear you.  We see you.

Even the contrast between the slow pacing of the lyrics with the buzzy, impossible rapidity of the choreo, conveys the impression:  extremes of labor and genius -- nearly invisible extremes of power latent in every flicker -- underlying the softness, the sweetness

The hidden cost, the underlying strength.  The barest, briefest glimpse of the power behind the apparent ease of perfection

Genius

PS Love the cheat sheet ☺️💜

In fact, the album is set up so that there are 2 songs in between both versions of Like Crazy. Streaming the album as a whole and getting max streams for ALL songs is essential in helping the album chart as high as possible. We want a #1 on BB200. 

You can easily stream the full album on one acct while streaming focused playlists on another and then switching. That's my plan at least. I am using more than one Spotify, Apple Music, and YouTube Music accts. I will be maxing album streams out on all. For example, one Apple account will be streaming the full album, the other will be streaming focused playlists. When I've maxed out my full album streams on one acct I'll switch that acct to focused playlists and get full album streams on the other acct. 

Big debut numbers are great for a song, but I want big debut numbers for the entire album. That means maxing out all streams for every song on the album, which helps us with numbers for BB200 

If you're not getting 20 streams for each song on this album you are making it harder for us to chart Face as high as possible on BB200
